commentary.text: 90+8' Romain Lissorgue is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick.
90+2' 3 - 1 Romain Del Castillo (Brest) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Djordje Petrovic with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 3:1.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' Oscar Perea (Strasbourg) has a goal ruled out for offside!

85' 2 - 1 Sebastian Nanasi is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the left post to make the score 2:1.
84' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Perea (Strasbourg) replacing Habib Diarra.
80' Here's the change. Mathias Pereira Lage leaves the pitch and Romain Del Castillo (Brest) comes on as a substitute.

78' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Marco Bizot makes a great save to stop his effort.
77' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Marco Bizot makes a comfortable save.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Romain Lissorgue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
73' The corner from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) is cleared away by the defence.

73' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Marco Bizot acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Strasbourg.
72' Flag up against Ludovic Ajorque (Brest). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
70' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' Here is a change. Felix Lemarechal is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
67' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Mama Balde is replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
67' That's the end of the game for Romain Faivre, who is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Brest).
65' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) brings his opponent down. Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Strasbourg.
64' The percentage of ball possession is – 35:65.
61' A cross from a corner kick by Strasbourg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

60' Strasbourg are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The ball is out of play and Strasbourg manage to earn a corner.
58' Andrey Santos slides a brilliant pass into Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
55' The Strasbourg players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
52' Djordje Petrovic anticipates the direction of the penalty by Ludovic Ajorque (Brest). He attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
52' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
51' Problems for Eric Roy as Edimilson Fernandes is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Hugo Magnetti (Brest) replaces him.
51' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) brings an opponent down and Romain Lissorgue interrupts the game. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Brest are awarded a penalty.
47' Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' Liam Rosenior makes a switch. Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) is coming on in place of Sekou Mara at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Strasbourg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

45+4' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.

45+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Julien Le Cardinal plays a long ball to Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 2:0.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
41' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Romain Lissorgue and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
40' Strasbourg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
37' The goal by Brest won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
37' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Brest players aren’t happy.
36' Goal! Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) coolly slotted the ball past the goalkeeper.
35' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Romain Lissorgue had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' What was Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

29' Romain Faivre (Brest) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Djordje Petrovic sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
27' Mama Balde (Brest) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
25' The current number of shots on goal is 5:0.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brest.
19' Kenny Lala (Brest) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Strasbourg, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
18' Romain Faivre (Brest) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
16' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.
15' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Brest win a corner.
14' Brest have been awarded a corner kick.

14' The game is pretty dull as Brest are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.
12' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kenny Lala (Brest) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic no chance!
12' Kenny Lala (Brest) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
11' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
11' Referee Romain Lissorgue makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Brest. Let’s see what happens!
11' That looked a certain handball by Guela Doue (Strasbourg) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
8' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
7' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) will take a corner kick.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Massadio Haidara (Brest). The referee signals a corner kick to Brest.
6' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
3' The Strasbourg players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
